prompts.title: Elite Stat Card
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the primary identity source. The generated portrait must match the same person exactly, preserving precise facial structure, head shape, jawline, cheekbones, eyes, nose, lips, hairstyle, glasses style, skin tone, and overall proportions. Maintain true identity fidelity and strong facial recognition accuracy. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter facial features. Preserve natural asymmetry, skin texture, and authentic likeness.
Create a highly stylized, ultra-detailed futuristic e-sports gaming profile card or “leader card” with a legendary-tier competitive aesthetic. The composition is in vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, centered, symmetrical, and designed like a premium digital character card from a modern competitive video game.
Central Portrait & Pose

The subject is centered in the frame, shown from mid-torso upward, facing forward with direct eye contact. He is making a confident “shushing” gesture, holding his right index finger vertically against his lips, conveying a calm, dominant, and quietly confident persona. His posture is upright and composed, with relaxed shoulders and balanced framing.
He is wearing a professional e-sports athletic jersey in black and electric blue, featuring realistic fabric texture, subtle stitching, breathable mesh panels, and modern competitive gaming uniform styling.
Background & Aura

Behind the subject’s head is a glowing circular digital halo or energy portal in bright neon blue, perfectly centered and symmetrical. The halo emits soft radial light rays and contains subtle sci-fi elements such as faint hexagonal grid patterns, floating digital particles, glowing data fragments, and atmospheric sparkles. The background fades into a deep dark blue and black gradient with depth, cinematic glow, and futuristic ambiance.
Card Frame & Border Design

The entire portrait is enclosed within a thick, metallic, futuristic frame with layered dimensional structure. The frame is made of brushed silver metal with illuminated neon accents in electric blue and subtle gold/yellow highlights. The corners are angular, geometric, and industrial, with glowing seams, reflective metallic edges, and sci-fi panel detailing. Soft light reflections and glow effects enhance the premium, legendary card appearance.
Typography & Branding

At the top center of the card, display the name:
“JACK XP”
in large, bold, futuristic sans-serif typography, white with bright blue neon glow, subtle metallic reflections, and soft bloom lighting.
Directly below it, display the title:
“LEADER”
in smaller, clean teal or cyan futuristic font with subtle glow.
On the subject’s chest area, overlay a shield-shaped crest logo with metallic gold and blue textures. The crest reads:
JACK XP

LEADER

ARMY
with layered typography, glowing accents, beveled metallic edges, and premium emblem styling.
Gaming Statistics Panel

At the bottom of the card, include a sleek futuristic stats panel with glowing borders and dark metallic background. Display the following performance metrics in high-contrast, bold, futuristic font:
HEADSHOT RATE: 97%

K/D RATIO: 5.2

WIN RATE: 93%
The numbers should be large, bright, and glowing in electric blue, with smaller white labels above them.
Lighting & Rendering Style

Use cinematic studio lighting combined with futuristic neon rim lighting. The face must remain clearly visible with realistic skin tone and proper exposure. Add soft blue rim light around the edges of the subject to integrate him naturally into the sci-fi environment. Include subtle glow bloom, volumetric light, and atmospheric depth.
Color Palette

Dominant colors: electric blue, deep navy blue, black, metallic silver

Accent colors: neon cyan, subtle gold/yellow highlights

Maintain high contrast, rich saturation, and premium digital finish.
Rendering Quality

Ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed, 8K resolution, professional e-sports character card, sharp focus, clean edges, cinematic contrast, advanced glow effects, realistic materials, and premium competitive gaming aesthetic.

prompts.title: PUBG Mobile
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, head to above the knees (mid-thigh crop) cinematic portrait of a rugged, athletic, slightly more muscular man with a broader, more muscular build, standing confidently in a smoky battlefield environment. Strong face resemblance to the reference image, matching facial structure, beard style, skin tone, and the same hairstyle with high identity consistency.
Add subtle but visible facial scars and battle marks: faint healed scratches across the cheekbones and near the eyebrow, light abrasion marks and dirt smudges on the face, slightly weathered skin with pores clearly visible.

Skin appears sweaty and heat-exposed with a natural oily shine: visible beads of sweat on the forehead, temples, nose bridge, cheeks, and neck; moist, slightly reflective skin highlights catching the light; subtle dampness around the hairline; faint perspiration darkening the shirt collar and upper chest area.
His expression is serious and focused, looking directly at the camera.
He wears a dirty, sweat-stained white button-down shirt with rolled sleeves and a loosened black necktie. A green military tactical backpack with thick straps sits on his shoulders, along with a side leg pouch attached to his belt. He is dressed in worn blue jeans and brown fingerless leather tactical gloves.
Resting over his right shoulder is a rusty cast-iron frying pan, held firmly in one hand like a weapon.
The background shows a foggy, desaturated battlefield scene with debris and smoke. A large military cargo aircraft flying in the distance appears blurred by atmospheric depth of field.
Cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, dramatic overcast lighting, realistic shadows, gritty survival aesthetic, ultra-detailed skin texture and fabric wrinkles, photorealistic color grading, volumetric haze, 8K resolution, sharp focus on subject, background bokeh, AAA video-game promotional art style.
Aspect ratio 4:5, head to above the knees (mid-thigh crop), not full body framing, centered composition.

prompts.title: Immersive Setup
prompts.prompt:
Transform the uploaded photo into an ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed cinematic photograph with DSLR quality, rendered in 32K resolution, with a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio.
🔒 Identity & Face Preservation (Very Important)
The subject’s face must remain 100% identical to the reference image.
Strictly preserve:

Facial structure
Bone geometry & proportions
Skin tone & natural texture
Eye shape, nose, jawline
Hairline, beard pattern (if present)
Expression & overall identity
No beautification, reshaping, stylization, smoothing, or identity drift.
👤 Subject
A handsome young man fully immersed in a gaming session.

His expression is focused, calm, and intense, with natural skin texture, visible pores, and realistic facial detail.

He is seated upright, typing on a keyboard and looking directly at the glowing screen.
💡 Lighting
Primary light: the gaming monitor in front of him, casting a cool blue glow on his face and glasses
Secondary light: a warm desk lamp from the side, creating soft rim light and depth
Cinematic contrast with realistic shadows and subtle highlights
👕 Wardrobe & Accessories
Black hoodie with “PROMPT PLUM” printed clearly on the chest
Luxury metal wristwatch
Modern blue-light glasses with subtle screen reflections
🖥 Environment
A dimly lit, premium gaming workspace:

Large gaming monitor in front
Gaming chair
Posters of popular video games on the wall behind him
A cup of hot coffee on the desk with visible steam
Headphones resting on the table
The mood should feel immersive, modern, and cinematic.
🎬 Final Style
Hyper-realistic textures (skin, fabric, glass, metal)
Cinematic depth of field
Editorial photography look
Clean high contrast
Natural lighting transitions
Sharp focus with soft background blur
Fully respect the original face and identity while transforming the scene into a cinematic, ultra-realistic gaming portrait.
